name: Home Assistant Voice PE
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks:
Select a profile depending on the LED ring setting of your Home Assistant Voice PE.

"+LED": LED ring is enabled (default). Higher standby power due to LED ring illumination.

"-LED": LED ring is turned off via the light entity (light.xxx_led_ring). Lower standby and playback power.
measure_description: Measured with utils/measure script. Two measurement runs: one with LED ring at 100% brightness (default), one with LED ring off.
